summary: Driftask CRM full-stack initial review. Backend: 23/23 pytest cases passed (auth register/login/me/duplicate-409/wrong-pw-401, contacts CRUD, deals CRUD + stage update, tasks CRUD + toggle, notes filter, dashboard stats shape, user isolation). Frontend: Onboarding (3 slides + skip + continue/get-started) -> login -> dashboard -> contacts (add/list) -> pipeline (add deal) -> tasks (add task) -> profile -> sign out, all working end-to-end against live backend.

minor.issue: Returns 403 (FastAPI HTTPBearer default) instead of 401 specified in test plan. Industry-acceptable; test accepts both.

integration_issues.issue: Sign out uses Alert.alert which on React-Native-Web does not render a visible confirm dialog in some browsers, so the user may not see the confirmation step. On native iOS/Android the standard alert will render correctly. Consider replacing with a cross-platform custom modal so the web preview also shows the confirmation. Logout logic itself is correct.

action_items: Optional: replace Alert.alert in profile.tsx sign-out flow with a custom Modal so confirmation is visible on web preview as well.

Optional (cosmetic): expo doctor warns about @react-native-async-storage/async-storage@3.0.2 (expected 2.2.0) and react-native-svg@15.15.4 (expected 15.12.1). App works fine, but version pinning could be aligned later.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 436-line file containing all routes/models. Acceptable for an MVP but should be split into routers (auth, contacts, deals, tasks, notes, dashboard) once it grows past ~700 lines.
DELETE endpoints return {'ok': true} with status 200 - functional but 204 No Content would be more REST-idiomatic.
Email is stored lowercased on register (good), and login lowercases input as well (good).
seed_data_creation: demo@driftask.app / demo123 already existed in DB. Test data created during runs (TEST_* prefixed contacts/deals/tasks) was cleaned up after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend public URL is https://driftask-connect.preview.emergentagent.com. Demo creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_driftask_api.py covers all CRUD + auth + isolation. Re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_driftask_api.py -v. UI flow: clear localStorage to land on onboarding; or set driftask_onboarded=1 and driftask_token to skip. All interactive elements have testIDs (login-*, contact-*, deal-*, task-*, profile-*, onboarding-*, stage-tab-*, stage-col-*, metric-card-*, bento-*).
rca_of_issue: No critical bugs found. The only observation is a UX nuance: Alert.alert does not render reliably in React-Native-Web preview, making the sign-out confirmation step appear unresponsive on web only. On real devices it works.
